title: When Does the Best Sampling Temperature Rise with the Budget? Sufficient Conditions for Pass@k
abstract: arXiv:2608.14665v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The temperature that maximizes pass@$k$ is often low for a small sampling budget and higher for a large budget. This pattern has been reported from Codex through recent multi-sample inference studies. It is not an algebraic property of pass@$k$: as Slocum et al. (ICLR 2025) observe, for one fixed task the maximizing temperature is independent of $k$. Building on that fixed-task observation and the hard/easy-task explanation, we give a formal population-level sufficient condition for the aggregate pattern. For task $X$, let $p_t(X)$ be one-sample success probability at temperature $t$, and define the conditional log-success response $m_t(u)=\mathbb{E}[\dot p_t(X)\mid p_t(X)=u]/u$. If $m_t(u)$ is nonincreasing in current success probability, then the normalized temperature derivative of aggregate pass@$k$ is nondecreasing in $k$. translated_title: 何时最佳采样温度随预算上升？Pass@k 的充分条件
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14665v1 公告类型：新 摘要：使 pass@$k$ 最大化的温度通常在小采样预算时较低，而在大预算时较高。这一模式已从 Codex 到近期的多样本推理研究中被报道。它并非 pass@$k$ 的代数性质：正如 Slocum 等人（ICLR 2025）所观察到的，对于单个固定任务，最大化温度与 $k$ 无关。基于这一固定任务观察和难/易任务解释，我们给出了聚合模式的一个正式总体层面的充分条件。对于任务 $X$，令 $p_t(X)$ 为温度 $t$ 下的单样本成功概率，并定义条件对数成功响应 $m_t(u)=\mathbb{E}[\dot p_t(X)\mid p_t(X)=u]/u$。如果 $m_t(u)$ 随当前成功概率非递增，则聚合 pass@$k$ 的归一化温度导数随 $k$ 非递减。因此，导数符号在预算间是嵌套的；如果每个温度-性能曲线严格正弦...
tldr: 本文提出了一个总体层面的充分条件，解释了为何最佳采样温度随预算增加而上升，并基于条件对数成功响应的单调性给出了严格的数学证明。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a population-level sufficient condition explaining why the optimal sampling temperature rises with the budget, with a rigorous proof based on the monotonicity of the conditional log-success response.
